case_number: 2025 INSC 61; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) OF 2025 [@DIARY NO. 7955 OF 2022] IN CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 1188 OF 2018 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Contempt petition regarding non-finalization of salary/pension arrears; absorption confirmed post-J. Sinha Commission order; ascertainable salary arrears paid but excess amount recoverable; pension withheld per prior orders; fact-finding enquiry required for actual working days; pension to be calculated from absorption date unaffected by contempt orders; directions issued for Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate claims within three months; liberty to approach High Court against orders.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of with directions for Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate salary/pension claims within three months; pension calculation unaffected by prior contempt orders; liberty to approach High Court against adjudication.
